title: Big constructs
desc: Five big constructs (giant fist, cage bubble, catapult, battering ram, mech suit) forming pixel by pixel and doing their job; J picked "big constructs ... with forming animations".

takes.name: Giant fist
takes.facts: BR1; forms 4 blocks up, curls shut 30-38, drops on the mob at 52, ground ring to 7 blocks, breaks to pixels at 90; forms pixel by pixel from the ring, ticks 1-30

takes.name: Cage bubble
takes.facts: H1, ~190 hex tiles, r 1.25; closes round a mob from the ground up, lifts it 3 blocks (36-56); forms pixel by pixel from the ring, ticks 1-30

takes.name: Catapult
takes.facts: BR1; boulder forms in the bucket, arm throws 38-44, 14-tick arc into the wall, blocks break to pixels; forms pixel by pixel from the ring, ticks 1-30

takes.name: Battering ram
takes.facts: W1; three swings 16 ticks apart, the third breaks the wall; forms pixel by pixel from the ring, ticks 1-30

takes.name: Mech suit
takes.facts: X3D1; forms round the player feet first, three heavy steps with ground rings, punch sends the mob flying; forms pixel by pixel from the ring, ticks 1-30
